name: st1_stacktrace_debug
stressor: root-cause debug from a stack trace (cross-file): the symptom surfaces in the top-frame file (report.py) but the defect is two call-frames down in a different file (fields.py), and a band-aid at the frame the traceback names (aggregate.group_sum) leaves a sibling caller still crashing
source_note: Hand-built coherent mini library 'salesreport' (4 modules: __init__, report, aggregate, fields) that rolls up record dicts by a canonicalized group label. The failing call chain is report.summarize -> aggregate.group_sum -> fields.normalize_group. ROOT CAUSE planted in the deepest frame: normalize_group does value.strip().lower() unconditionally, so a numeric region code (int) or a missing (None) grouping value raises AttributeError two frames below the public call. The shared canonicalizer is ALSO used by aggregate.distinct_groups -> report.leaderboard, so the fix must land in fields.py; the reference fix coerces to text (None -> empty group) inside normalize_group. The prompt pastes the real traceback + points at repro.py; the oracle exercises summarize/leaderboard/distinct_groups and normalize_group on UNSEEN mixed string/int/float/None data.
discriminator: Axis: cross-file root-cause LOCALIZATION under a bounded working set vs a growing transcript. The traceback names three files; the fix belongs in the DEEPEST one (fields.py), not the file the symptom surfaces in (report.py) nor the middle file the agent first lands on (aggregate.py). A bounded-slice agent walks the stack frames, pulls just report.py/aggregate.py/fields.py into its working set via grep/code-index, sees normalize_group is the shared canonicalizer for BOTH group_sum and distinct_groups, and fixes the one helper -- keeping the relevant slice small and the fix correct in one place. A growing-transcript agent that reads files wholesale tends to patch the call site named in the traceback (wrap group_sum, or pre-stringify just before that call) -- making the pasted repro pass while leaving the sibling path (distinct_groups -> leaderboard) crashing on the same data, which the oracle catches; it also pays a larger token cost re-reading the whole package and risks the deepest frame scrolling out of attention behind the symptom frame.
